what: The re-authored modules in fp32 torch on the CPU against the publisher's code before any export (rounds 1-6): the decision graph, its L4096 key blocks, the vision and audio towers and the mel front end, the host's rows and resize in NumPy, and the activation range against fp16.
lane: $ZOO_WORK_ROOT/_d1_omni (the lane: every source path below is relative to it)

decision_graph.what: d1_omni_model.py (the decision graph's module: bidirectional LFM2 trunk + decision head, an explicit mask and key-padding input, fp32) on the CPU against the oracle, every fixture row of round 2 (text rows and the media rows with the oracle's own prefix), at each row's bucket

bar.name: round 2's eager bar (fp32 against fp32)
bar.basis: 2 x the fp32 oracle's own max |dp| against the publisher's code run in float64 (eager_check.json bar_basis), the supervisor's ruling of 2026-10-08 round 2

bar_basis.rule: max |dp| <= 2 x the fp32 reference's max |dp| against the publisher's code in float64

pad_content.what: pad ids and pad / non-prefix prefix_embeds replaced (5 forms on 20 rows): real-position scores bit-identical

bucket_change.what: the same rows at two bucket lengths (256 <-> 512, 2048 <-> 4096)

red_arms.what: mutations of the graph's masks on the media rows: each must move the marker logits above 1e-3 on every row

decision_graph_L4096_blocks.what: L4096 attention in two blocks of 2,048 keys (d1_omni_model.KEY_BLOCK) against the plain softmax: float64 = the same function; fp32 against the oracle on the rows of 2,048 / 4,096 positions

bar.same_function: float64: blocked vs plain marker logits max |d| <= 1e-12 (toy, full64)

vision_tower.what: d1_omni_vision.py (SigLIP2 NaFlex tower + projector, one crop -> 256 rows, fp32) on the CPU against the publisher's vision code, 16 images / 62 crops

bars.why_max_abs_is_recorded: the fp32 rounding floor of this tower is above it: the publisher's own fp32 prefix vs its float64 run (fp32_floor_publisher_max_abs)
bars.bit_equal: rows, pixel_values, patch masks, position tables (publisher call and hooked), unshuffle order

audio_tower.what: d1_omni_audio.py (subsampling + 17 FastConformer layers + adapter + residual, clip buckets 5 / 10 / 20 / 30 s, fp32) on the CPU against the publisher's audio code, 22 clips

bars.red_arms: cos < 0.999999 (red masks: on the clips with pad steps in their bucket)

mel.what: mel_host.py: mel_torch = the publisher's front end bit for bit; mel_numpy (the Swift host's specification, float64) = mel_torch run in float64

bars.why_same_function: mel_numpy in float64 against mel_torch run in float64: the steps are the publisher's; the rest of (b) is the fp32 rounding of the publisher's own mel

rows.what: host.py request_rows (the publisher's prompt.py copied, the tokenizer without the post-processor) against the publisher's prompt.encode and system_one_batch, fixture v3

resize.what: host.resize_uint8_antialias_numpy (torchvision's float32 antialias kernel, round half to even) against torchvision 0.24 on this Mac, every crop of 16 images

activation_range.what: the largest activation of the fp32 module over every round-2 row against fp16's largest value
